item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is better than the previous tales, but still badly paced, and some developments seem unreasonable given the characters. Most of all, I don't see why the girl would care about the journey itself, though I do see her worrying about the lizard. If there was a development from her worry for the lizard to she reaching the conclusion that the journey is necessary for 682 to not succumb to depression, that would be better.

As it is, until now those tales seem like a rough sketch of a story that was not fleshed out before being thrown here.

item.title: Author commentary.
item.content:encoded:
Yet another installment in the Those Who Lived On series.

New SCPs shown or alluded to in the series:
SCP-354, also was inspired by its attached exploration log.
SCP-712, were some of the colors behind the second wall.
SCP-409, inspired the rock-snake-things.
Oh, and Tooki? Tooki isn't an SCP. Tooki is just Tooki.

Hope you enjoy it.
